conform_rule: Check captureFps, formatFps and RecordingMode. Do not double slow already conformed footage.
speed_rule: No automatic speedups; preserve complete gestures. Native slow where action supports it; deliberate intermediate speeds allowed.
colour: Official Sony LC709 once for confirmed SLog3/SGamut3.Cine; no guessed LUT on unknown profiles.
portrait: Full bleed; native portrait alternates or editor seeded, visually reviewed CSRT. Reject semantic drift even when tracker reports success.
audio: Both supplied tracks at100% native speed and pitch. Video slow motion must never stretch music. Use musical phrase edits/short native-speed repeats when necessary, with documented source ranges; exchange rhythms at different-tempo joins.48kHz; -14LUFS target, <=-1dBTP.
transitions: Short source-handle blends and motivated directional/blur cuts, no random flashes.
approval: Preset is editorial configuration, not user approval of a render.
beat_alignment: Hard cut on pulse; blended transition midpoint on pulse, not simply transition start. Align selected action contact/release moments independently; preserve complete gestures.
